findings.explanation: This clause assigns your intellectual property rights immediately upon creation or prior to full payment, leaving you without ownership protection if the client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Upon payment in full of all Fees and amounts due under this Agreement, Developer assigns and transfers to Client all copyright and other intellectual property ownership in the Works.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to suggest an adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, it assigns intellectual property rights before full payment is made, which leaves ownership unprotected if payment is delayed. I propose updating this to: Upon payment in full of all Fees and amounts due under this Agreement, Developer assigns and transfers to Client all copyright and other intellectual property ownership in the Works. Looking forward to finalizing this. Best regards,
